SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'FASH' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, ISNULL(RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM PO_KEP_RCV_V, PO_KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 *= LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEY_2 *= LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND KEY_3 *= LEGACY_GR_NO AND KEY_4 *= LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ
UPDATE PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') AND DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN'
